headline: Head coach Kyle Shanahan makes franchise history
summary: The 49ers' win against the Broncos marks Kyle Shanahan's 167th franchise win, surpassing Bill Walsh for the all-time franchise record.

headline: Sources: Packers LB Edgerrin Cooper has torn Achilles
summary: Packers linebacker Edgerrin Cooper suffered a season-ending Achilles tear during Sunday's 17-14 victory over the Buccaneers, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

headline: Broncos get good news on Pat Surtain II's ankle, sources say
summary: Broncos star cornerback Pat Surtain II avoided a worst-case scenario on his ankle injury, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

headline: Steelers To Sign CB Sean Murphy-Bunting Off Buccaneers’ Practice Squad
summary: In need of healthy cornerback options, the Steelers are in line to add a veteran to the mix. Sean Murphy-Bunting is being signed off the Buccaneers’ practice squad, The Ringer’s Tom Pelissero reports. Pittsburgh’s Joey Porter Jr. saga came to an end last week when he was traded to the Cowboys. That move did not come as a surprise […]

headline: Report: Rashawn Slater believed to have a high-ankle sprain
summary: The Chargers saw left tackle Rashawn Slater get hurt in Sunday's loss to the Seahawks and the 0-4 team is reportedly set to be without him for a while.

headline: Ben Johnson: Tyson Bagent will start at QB for Bears vs. Packers
summary: Tyson Bagent will be the Bears' starting quarterback for Sunday's game at the Packers, coach Ben Johnson announced Monday.
